items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: we needed a guitar and we brought in Lawrence Lucie.

ctx.x: You had to play waltzes and everything -- you know, fox trots and everything. And it was a good learning thing, because you got a chance to really learn all the music -- the different styles and things you never even played.
It really was a breaking out point. And I've never forget when we got Lawrence (inaudible) -- I was with him for about six months and we needed a guitar and we brought in Lawrence Lucie.
And Lawrence Lucie was just begin to --
